buyBody: All black, blade collar, no buttons. The plainest shirt in the range and the one most likely to be worn twice a week.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body. Raking side light is mandatory. The pattern is tonal and in flat light this photographs as a plain black shirt, which undersells it.
